title: Asteroid collision
statementMd:
Asteroids move along a line; positive values move right, negative left, magnitude is size, all move at the same speed. When two meet the smaller explodes (equal sizes both explode). Return the survivors in order.

**Example:** `asteroid_collision([5, 10, -5])` returns `[5, 10]`.
hints: Stack: resolve collisions when the new one moves left.
